title: Nee Swarame Vinna – Joshua Shaik Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీ స్వరమే విన్నా – నీ మమతే కన్నా
నా చెలిమే నీవై – నీ ప్రేమే నాదై
english: Nee swarame vinnaa – nee mamathe kannaa
naa chelime neevai – nee preme naadai
intro: Nee Swarame Vinna is the latest Telugu Christian song written and produced by Joshua Shaik sung by Ankona Mukherjee and music composed by Thrahimam fame, Pranam Kamlakhar. This song video was released on June 13, 2024 through Joshua Shaik Ministries YouTube channel.
